question: Who among the following astrologers passed away in May 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bejan Daruwala.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bejan Daruwala** passed away in May 2020.
 
• Bejan Jehanjir Daruwalla was an **Indian English professor and astrology columnist.**
 
• Daruwalla was a** Ganesha devotee and **practiced various divination systems.
